profiles.fixture_provenance: Synthetic public authored rectangle/ellipse and native coupled-anchor/primitive fixtures. Exact source/handle/copy/deletion/callback controls, DOCX ZIP/native readback,2pt outline/fill native-versus-PDF full-page colors at72/144/300DPI, body links/table/note-story/image preservation, document shape_geometry_omitted diagnostic and native malformed/budget/locator tests. Separate116 native upgrade evidence supplies0.25/2/100pt corners/outlines and bounded min-dimension ratio cases; it must be cited as native evidence, not described as public full-range tests. No independent Microsoft Word acceptance or arbitrary imported-shape preservation.

read.scope: owned handles read supported properties; reopened semantic extraction omits shape geometry with its existing document diagnostic and does not fabricate image/text geometry. Native DOCX readback checks selected properties; this is not general shape extraction.

create.scope: append native inline rectangles/ellipses with optional solid fill/outline, serialized through native DOCX writer; bounded factory/placeholder/resource checks. Other shape kinds/contexts remain excluded.

edit_authored.scope: resize/recolor/change solid outline or shared placement, delete one shape retaining its paragraph/section, and retain surviving identities around body table/paragraph edits. Exact ownership, callback revision, full-outline and orientation guards reject unsafe changes atomically. No movement/text/rotation manager.

edit_imported.scope: Owned Office models do not adopt arbitrary imported shape graphs, stories or relationship identities.

preserve.scope: retain demonstrated body text/external URL/bookmark/table/note story/image, unrelated handles, copies and empty section anchors through supported edits. Do not claim opaque/imported shape parts or arbitrary rich-text-box preservation.

render.scope: native PNG of supported source/reopened rectangles/ellipses;2pt public outline/fill placement controls at72/144/300DPI. Separate116 native cap/join+ratio evidence required for bounded outline range. Finite exact dimension/cardinality/full-outline guards and output limits remain; no pixel-perfect claim.

export.scope: native DOCX-to-PDF export, reopened PDF text/links/table/note and selected color geometry compared to source PNG. Same bounded range and116 native evidence prerequisite; no new conversion pair or general drawing fidelity guarantee.
